notes: KonoSuba light novel feats inform overall powers; artwork is the identified character and not proof of unseen form-specific gear. All tiers are NIGHT editorial hypotheses, never official numerical rankings.

aqua-adventurer.basis: Purifies poisoned waters, defeats undead through divine holy arts, restores allies and resurrects the recently dead.
aqua-adventurer.limits: Anti-undead and anti-devil specialization; intelligence and battle choices impair practical outcomes.

vanir-masked.basis: Duke of Hell with foresight, devastating magic, possession and enough extra lives that he cannot count them.
vanir-masked.limits: Can lose a manifested body; holy purifiers are dangerous and clairvoyance has exclusions.

wiz-lich.basis: Extremely powerful lich mage with devastating spellcraft, drain touch and unusual undead survival.
wiz-lich.limits: Holy purification remains a critical counter; shopkeeper outfit is not a separate power form.

iris-royal.basis: Royal training, inherited magic and exceptional combat potential established in the novels.
iris-royal.limits: Official portrait is civilian dress; no Aigis armour or ultimate equipment is claimed here.

megumin-explosion.basis: Exceptional one-shot destructive Explosion magic capable of defeating formidable enemies.
megumin-explosion.limits: Normally unable to cast again without rest or externally supplied mana.

yunyun-archwizard.basis: Advanced, flexible elemental magic, tactical awareness and reliable repeat casting.
yunyun-archwizard.limits: Less peak one-hit destructive output than Explosion magic.

mitsurugi-gram.basis: A powerful swordfighter using the divinely granted magical sword Gram.
mitsurugi-gram.limits: Power is weapon-dependent; removing Gram drastically changes this assessment.

darkness-crusader.basis: Near-unmatched damage absorption, endurance and exceptional physical strength.
darkness-crusader.limits: Attacks seldom connect; durability must not be mistaken for reliable offensive output.

kazuma-adventurer.basis: Excellent luck and tactical skill; Steal, Bind, Drain Touch and combinations compensate for lower stats.
kazuma-adventurer.limits: Not a direct physical equal of top generals; Demon King victory is highly conditional.

chris-thief.basis: Exceptional luck, movement, stealth, escape and thief utility.
chris-thief.limits: This is not unrestricted Eris; hidden divine identity does not automatically grant full heavenly authority.

rain-mage.basis: Competent court mage and royal escort with sustained spellcasting.
rain-mage.limits: Not established above elite archwizards in direct offence.

megumin-student.basis: Gifted Crimson Demon magic student before developing her later Explosion-focused combat specialization.
megumin-student.limits: Early academy form; must not receive late-series repeated Explosion feats.

megumin-journey.basis: Newly acquired top-tier Explosion magic and strong raw magical potential.
megumin-journey.limits: Single cast exhausts her and battle experience is still limited.

yunyun-student.basis: Magically gifted Crimson Demon apprentice with conventional tactical discipline.
yunyun-student.limits: Earlier training stage lacks mature archwizard mastery.

yunyun-journey.basis: Advanced spell training with a versatile combat toolkit compared with the average adventurer.
yunyun-journey.limits: Earlier experience level, not the late-series specialist.

komekko-child.basis: Surprising affinity for dangerous creatures and summoned entities, with natural Crimson Demon talent.
komekko-child.limits: Her summoning success is situation-dependent; she lacks proven sustained duelling feats.

arue-student.basis: Trained Crimson Demon magical talent with potential offensive spellcasting.
arue-student.limits: School-era student; no inferred late-series ultimate techniques.

cecily-priest.basis: Religious spellcaster with healing and clerical utility.
cecily-priest.limits: Limited demonstrated high-end offensive feats and low tactical reliability.
